notes:
Describes something that deviates from the standard rule or pattern. Composed of ⟦{変|へん}→変：01124_hen⟧ (change, abnormal) and {則|そく} (rule). Used frequently in sports, work scheduling, and grammar to describe non-standard arrangements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {変則|へんそく}{的|てき}: irregular, unconventional
- {変則|へんそく}⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧: irregular work shifts
- {変則|へんそく}⟦ダブル→ダブル：24220_daburu⟧ヘッダー: split doubleheader (baseball)
- {変則|へんそく}⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧: irregular schedule

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不規則|ふきそく}→不規則：15651_fukisoku⟧: irregular — emphasizes lack of regularity or pattern
- ⟦{異例|いれい}→異例：13564_irei⟧: exceptional, unprecedented — implies rarity
- ⟦{例外|れいがい}→例外：03798_reigai⟧: exception — a specific case that deviates from a rule
